params.prompt: Candid UGC iPhone photo of a real American woman in her mid-40s, shoulder-length wavy brown hair, light freckles, wearing a relaxed cream knit sweater, standing in her sunny kitchen near a white marble countertop. She is smiling warmly, mid-laugh, about to pop a small dark green heart-shaped Motilli gummy into her mouth, holding the gummy between her thumb and finger near her smile. The open Motilli green celery juice fiber gummies bottle sits on the counter beside her with a few more dark green heart gummies spilled next to it; a coffee mug is also on the counter. Bright natural window light, real lived-in home kitchen with light wood cabinets and a small basil plant on the sill. Photoreal, iPhone camera quality, slight warmth, no studio lighting.
